text.en: Jonaki began in [[calcutta|Calcutta]] in 1889, connected with the [[asamiya-bhasha-unnati-sadhini-sabha|Asamiya Bhasha Unnati Sadhini Sabha]]. Print gave young Assamese writers a shared space beyond Assam itself.
text.as: [[asamiya-bhasha-unnati-sadhini-sabha|অসমীয়া ভাষা উন্নতি সাধিনী সভা]]ৰ সৈতে জড়িত জোনাকী ১৮৮৯ ত [[calcutta|কলিকতা]]ত আৰম্ভ হয়। ছপাই অসমৰ বাহিৰতো ডেকা অসমীয়া লেখকক উমৈহতীয়া ঠাই দিলে।

text.en: [[chandra-kumar-agarwala|Chandra Kumar Agarwala]] was its first editor. Jonaki became associated with a new literary phase, including romantic poetry and modern prose.
